==Dialogue==
:''"Hello, my name is Yapono. For many years now I have been the top hunter in the land. I can sniff out and track down any animal known to man. I can track a falcon on a cloudy day. I can find anything and anyone. My skills are second only to the [[The Great Zehtuka|Great Zehtuka's]]."''

==Trivia==
* His claim that he can track a falcon on a cloudy day is a reference to [[w:The Princess Bride (film)|The Princess Bride]], in which Buttercup makes the same claim for Prince Humperdink.
